name: Masonry Gallery
summary: Passive ordered artwork gallery with intrinsic multi-columns, natural media proportions, and optional persistent captions.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native ordered gallery list whose source sequence remains authoritative.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Repeated native list item kept intact inside a multi-column track.

anatomy.name: piece
anatomy.description: Passive artwork figure in the canonical candidate; target-native interaction remains an unresolved composition boundary.

anatomy.name: image
anatomy.description: Target-owned responsive artwork image with contextual alt intent and natural dimensions.

anatomy.name: overlay
anatomy.description: Optional persistent caption surface for passive artwork metadata.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Passive source-ordered gallery with optional captions.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One to three columns resolve intrinsically from the gallery content box.

states.name: pieceHover
states.description: Optional fine-pointer disclosure state only when a target supplies a native interactive root.

states.name: pieceFocus
states.description: Visible keyboard focus and persistent metadata disclosure for target-native interaction.

behavior.name: sourceOrder
behavior.description: The target-authored DOM order remains the reading order; no dense placement or visual reordering is allowed.

behavior.name: intrinsicColumns
behavior.description: One, two, or three multi-columns resolve from the component content box without page viewport queries or runtime measurement.

behavior.name: naturalMedia
behavior.description: Artwork retains target-provided natural dimensions; crop, responsive sources, loading, and focal point remain target-owned.

behavior.name: passiveCaption
behavior.description: Caption metadata remains visibly persistent whenever the piece is passive and must never depend on hover.

behavior.name: interactionBoundary
behavior.description: This contract does not decide whether a piece is passive, a link, or a Lightbox trigger. Targets must use semantically valid native interactive composition and keyboard behavior if activation is added.

behavior.name: interactiveDisclosure
behavior.description: Only a target-native interactive root may use fine-pointer hover disclosure, paired with focus-visible disclosure and reduced-motion support.

behavior.name: runtimeBoundary
behavior.description: Neutral Web uses no component JavaScript, observer, listener, layout read, request, or timer.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Target-owned ordered artwork items, including media and optional metadata.

accessibility: Give every meaningful artwork image useful alternative text and mark decorative images accordingly.
Keep passive title and price metadata visibly available without hover; only native interactive target composition may pair hover with focus-visible disclosure.
Preserve target-authored source order and do not use dense placement or CSS order to repack artwork.
When a target makes a piece interactive, use a native link or button with a descriptive accessible name and visible focus.
Lightbox focus management, dismissal, and restoration belong to the composed Lightbox or target adapter, not this gallery contract.

shopify.notes: A localized section maps ordered artwork blocks to passive native list and figure markup without assuming activation.
